chunks: This is surely in the earlier Books

key_terms.الصُّحُفِ: Plural of Suhuf, referring to the sacred scriptures or scrolls revealed to earlier prophets

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'the earlier Books' (Suhuf al-Aula)?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-A'la affirms the continuity of divine revelation by linking the Quranic message to the primordial scriptures (Suhuf) revealed to earlier prophets like Abraham and Moses. In Shia exegesis, this underscores the authenticity of the Quran as the final, preserved culmination of the same core monotheistic truth, validating the prophetic lineage and the concept of Tawatur in transmission.
